M0-T2.notes: VERDICT: proven. White-box stand-ins for all 6 module types joined socket-to-socket: 78 joins @ zero offset → max seam gap/lateral/vertical/floorStep = 0.000000 mm (join math is never the error source). Offset response linear & axis-separated (normal δ → open seam δ; lateral δ → misalign δ; vertical δ swallowed by floor pin / becomes door-miss+floor-step under door solve). Authoring noise ±0.5 mm → ≤1.0 mm bounds (2× margin vs 2 mm watertight cap, 5× vs 5 mm hatch cap; ±1.0 mm = zero headroom → 0.5 mm is the authoring ceiling). Pathological joins (≥10 mm offsets; engineering 1.2 m high-hatch vs standard 1.0 m door → 200 mm step) exceed both caps → validator reject set. Decision: sockets are the ONLY join interface (M3-T2 'never freehand' now measured, not asserted); floor-pinned assembly (walkable deck plates) with XZ from sockets; tolerances fixed in src/spikes/seams/tolerances.ts (imported by M0-T6/M1-T3): watertightGapMm 2, hatchAlignMm 5, maxSocketAuthoringErrorMm 0.5, standardDoorCenterM 1.0. (1) CI workflow authored (3 jobs on push(main)+PR: static = npm ci / lint / format:check / typecheck / check:slots; test = vitest run; build = npm run build; Node 22, npm cache). BLOCKER: the workflow file CANNOT live at .github/workflows/ci.yml yet - GitHub refuses any push that creates/updates .github/workflows/** unless the credential has the `workflow` scope (classic PAT) or `Workflows: Read and write` (fine-grained); the push was rejected with "refusing to allow a Personal Access Token to create or update workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml without workflow scope". Both credentials on this box are classic PATs with `repo` scope only (~/.git-credentials line and $GH_TOKEN; no SSH key is authorized, ~/.hermes/tokens/ is empty; see ~/notes/github-token-strategy.md, whose target Tier-1 machine token carries Workflows R/W). So the workflow is checked in at ci/github-actions-ci.yml with a header + README note giving the one-command activation: `git mv ci/github-actions-ci.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml` from a workflow-scoped credential, then push. CI does NOT run until then; npm run verify is the gate in the meantime. (2) Material-slot completeness = "unassigned slot = failed build" (PRD §7) is now enforced twice: compile-time via MaterialSlots<T> (M1-T2) and runtime via assertThemesComplete() run by scripts/check-material-slots.ts, the first step of npm run build and its own CI step.
